Urgent: Missing Cat!
Name: Snowy
Gender: Male
Description: White fur and friendly toward strangers. Performs a backflip when fed.

Snowy, my thirteen-year-old cat, ran away from home nine days ago after refusing to eat. I'm very worried about him! In human terms, he is roughly equivalent to a seventy-year-old and is in poor health due to frequent backflips.

If you happen to see or purchase him as a pet, please bring him to the well in Lumivale and contact Monjo. Your kindness will be generously rewarded!

紧急，寻猫启事！
姓名：小白
性别：公猫
特征：白色毛发，不惧生人，若投喂食物，会在原地后空翻
13岁的小白，九天前因绝食而离家出走，至今杳无音讯。小白相当于人类70多岁，因长期后空翻，身体也不好，我非常担心它！
请看到、买到或捡到的好心人到求知魔法村的水井附近，与蒙乔联系，定有重谢！
